title: HELP: Can anybody create an Muse from Meta account for me? I'm in area outside US and it doesn't allow to create an account from here
author: sol424242
selftext: I've had an Meta Muse account, but I accidentally connected to it without my IP/location masking and it got blocked. Now they've upgraded their registration processes so it's not easy to get an account outside allowed areas.

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: That has nothing to do with ai game dev and smells like a scam….

replies.author: sol424242
replies.body: Hi I'm developing games too but it's not my primary focus... I'm not using reddit too much but at least, i've tried if someone can create account for me if I can't.

comments.author: Soul_Mate_4ever
comments.body: Sure send me your bank account number and pin. I’ll get on it.

comments.author: RegioMamalon666
comments.body: Absolutely hell no, even less with a sketchy account with no activity/ karma.

replies.author: sol424242
replies.body: thanks for your point of view. I understand that. I'm not using Reddit much. Now I've tried.  I wasn't prepared for this much refusal from all of you.

replies.body: You need to learn more about the internet if you honestly think this is normal
